sarah-cs: FYI Acme team hitting bursts of 429s when they spin up their front-end. Reported some intermittent 401s during the same window. Can someone from eng take a quick look? 
acme-onboard: We ramp from 0->200 clients quickly during tests. Using browser SDK 0.7.3, we call init() in each worker and immediately preflight a few endpoints. Attached logs show many preflight 401 then retry 429.
acme-onboard: snippet:
```js
// runs on page load
const client = new RedwoodClient({key: window.__ACME_KEY});
for (let i=0;i<8;i++) fetchPrefetch(client);
```
meera-devex: thanks — two quick asks: 1) are you using ephemeral keys per-tab? 2) do you see the Authorization header present on the first request?
acme-onboard: ephemeral per-session yes, created on our auth server. Header present most of the time but ~5% first requests show missing or short-lived token errors.
vinny-eng: likely a stampede + jitter issue. When many tabs/workers call init() they cause a throttle at the preflight layer. Short-term mitigation: debounce preflight and add jitter + exponential backoff on 429. Also please avoid creating a fresh ephemeral key per worker.
vinny-eng: suggested client change (quick):
```diff
- const client = new RedwoodClient({key: window.__ACME_KEY});
+ // reuse a single session key across workers and stagger prefetch
+ const sessionKey = window.__ACME_KEY;
+ const client = new RedwoodClient({key: sessionKey, prefetchDelay: 50, maxConcurrency: 4});
```
meera-devex: note for CS playbook: recommend setting prefetchDelay >= 40ms for browser SDKs on high-concurrency pages and enable token cache on client side. I'll add doc blurb. :memo:
acme-onboard: ok will try. Any server-side quick fixes?
vinny-eng: server-side we can temporarily increase the token validation window (grace period) and allow coalescing of identical preflight requests for 200s. I can request a short-lived config bump for your org if you want. @sarah-cs can authorize?
sarah-cs: yea go ahead, authorize the bump for acme-onboard for the next 48h. Keep me posted. :+1:
deploy-bot: scheduled config change for org acme-onboard at 2026-03-25T15:00:00Z (id: cfg-7832)
acme-onboard: rolled the client change, staging looks much better — 429s reduced to near-zero during warmups. We still saw two 401s tied to token refresh race.
vinny-eng: for token refresh race add a small mutex / single-flight on the client so only one inflight refresh proceeds; others wait for the new token. Also splay refresh timers by random(0..3000)ms.
meera-devex: follow-ups: I will PR a short snippet into the onboarding guide, vinny can you open a runtime ticket to expose prefetchDelay in the hosted SDK docs? acme-onboard, please share a small repro if you still see 401 after mutex.
acme-onboard: will do, thanks all. This callout saved our go-live window. :tada:
